'''Star-mist''' was a type of flower that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].

==History==
The [[Tarasin]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species that was native to Cularin, would collect and dry star-mist plants and then burn them, which produced fumes that caused mild euphoric effects. However, other species did not experience such effects.

During the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Selima DeWitt]] established the shop [[Natural]] on Cularin and sold star-mist there, because the flowers smelled pleasant and were popular with customers. Her business partner, the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[biochemist]] [[Higgie Sethven]], studied star-mist and discovered that if crushed star-mist was boiled in alcohol and allowed to dry, a lilac-colored substance that stimulated nerve regrowth was produced.<ref name="Find the Lady">{{LivingForce|Trade Wars: Find the Lady}}</ref>
